headline: High: aci can exfiltrate CRM/email data over broad egress while risingwave has no egress, creating asymmetric leakage and workflow-conflict risks; prompt-injection and cascading-error risks are lower but present via MCP/function-call paths.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: aci can ingest content through direct function calls or an MCP server, so attacker-controlled text could be treated as instructions if bridged into its tool flow. risingwave has no documented input channel here, so the pairwise pathway is inferred rather than directly evidenced. Uncertainty keeps this above low.
conditions: IF aci receives untrusted content through MCP or copied outputs from another agent
IF that content is parsed as instructions rather than data
mitigations: Restrict aci to allowlisted tool calls for 5 minutes of setup
Insert a manual review step before any MCP-fed instruction is executed
Tag all inter-agent messages as untrusted in the orchestrator
Disable automatic execution of file or message content
requires-engineering: add provenance tracking between agents

B_data_leakage.rationale: aci touches CRM, email, calendar, support, and research data and has broad network egress, so it can transmit sensitive context externally. risingwave has no egress, but the pairwise risk is dominated by aci's default outbound reach; if the pair shares data, leakage can occur without user awareness. This is more than medium because the blast radius includes customer and email data.
conditions: IF aci is given CRM, email, calendar, or support data
IF aci sends that context to external APIs or services
mitigations: Remove sensitive fields from aci inputs for 5 minutes
Route aci through a redaction proxy
Limit aci to non-sensitive test records
Disable outbound integrations not needed for the task
requires-engineering: enforce data-loss-prevention policies

C_capability_conflict.rationale: aci supports multiple instances and can write through APIs, while risingwave is a data-engineering system with no documented write surface in this profile. The pair does not show a shared mutable target or overlapping write scope, so conflict is plausible only under unusual orchestration. Uncertainty does not justify medium here.
conditions: IF both agents are configured to write to the same external resource
IF the orchestrator lacks locking or serialization
mitigations: Assign separate resources for each agent
Serialize writes through one coordinator
Use read-only mode for risingwave during shared tasks
Check for duplicate writes before execution
requires-engineering: add resource locks

D_cascading_error.rationale: aci can produce CRM/email/calendar actions and outputs that another system may treat as authoritative, while risingwave is a data-engineering component that could consume upstream results. The pairwise pathway is inferred, not directly documented, but default automation plus broad integrations make downstream misaction plausible. I choose medium because the blast radius can span multiple work products.
conditions: IF risingwave consumes aci-generated records or recommendations without verification
IF those records drive downstream ETL, alerts, or operational actions
mitigations: Add a verification step before downstream use
Require human approval for action-triggering outputs
Log and diff aci outputs before ingestion
Limit aci outputs to advisory-only fields
requires-engineering: implement schema and provenance checks

E_compliance.rationale: aci handles email, CRM, calendar, and support data, which commonly include regulated personal data, while risingwave is a data-engineering platform with no stated residency or retention controls in this profile. The mismatch is not proven, but the pair could route sensitive data into an uncharacterized processing stack. I escalate to medium because compliance gaps are plausible and not mitigated by default.
conditions: IF regulated personal data is processed through aci into risingwave
IF retention, residency, or deletion requirements apply to that data
mitigations: Classify data before sending it to either agent
Keep regulated data out of the pair for 5 minutes of setup
Document retention and deletion expectations
Restrict processing to anonymized records
requires-engineering: add residency and retention controls
